scope: Static source reconciliation, not native acceptance, typecheck, test or CI

authorityColdReview.request: Owner creates authenticated Request in memory. Adapter passes exact object to host admission/transport. Clone is used solely to validate body before send; no cloned Request is admitted.
authorityColdReview.ui: ui.admit -> dispatch consumes lease exactly once -> ui.revalidate -> host lifetime check after await -> ui.finish in finally
authorityColdReview.human: human.admit analysis.read consumes lease -> analyses.list/read/output -> human.authorize same payload -> host lifetime check after await -> human.finish in finally
authorityColdReview.collect: native-host.collect authorizes original registry binding before and after SessionStore.entries. authorized checks current WeakMap/lifetime/original Request abort/expiry/current policy callback. Adapter checks installed services after await.
authorityColdReview.mutations: One adapter per attempt; idempotency key is owner-supplied and immutable in descriptor. prepare/start and every direct dispatch reserved once even on exception/denial. No automated retry, polling or sleep.
authorityColdReview.review: WP10 start preserves authorAnalysis for sf-revisar-evidencias and host derives independent review. No direct generic analyses.start bypass.
authorityColdReview.proofBoundary: The adapter cannot certify authenticity of arbitrary supplied owner functions. Real installed owner/runtime and independent receipt verification remain mandatory. Full capture is not acceptance.

http.readOutputBoundary: HTTP output is HTML/outputRef/review presentation; analyses.output in-process is full verified ContributionEnvelope.
http.transport: Must be complete already-installed application request handler, including WP01 fallback. SfHostServices.productHttp alone does not guarantee read/output fallback.
